key: "LCCC L-C Unlocked."
en: "LCCC L-C Unlocked."
ja: 『LCCC L-C ロック解除。』

key: The computer seems to be unresponsive. A small port in the front is exposed.
en: The computer seems to be unresponsive. A small port in the front is exposed.
ja: コンピューターは反応しないようだ。正面に小さなポートが露出している。

key: Plug in the Data Chip?
en: Plug in the Data Chip?
ja: データチップを差し込む?

key: \PN inserted the Data Chip into the port...
en: \PN inserted the Data Chip into the port...
ja: \PNはポートにデータチップを差し込んだ……

key: "PULSE-09"
en: "PULSE-09"
ja: 『PULSE-09』

key: mMmMmMmMmM???
en: mMmMmMmMmM???
ja: ンムムムムムムムム???

key: FLORA: \PN.
en: FLORA: \PN.
ja: フローラ: \PN。

key: It smells down here.
en: It smells down here.
ja: ここ、下は臭いわね。

key: Like, I'm not talking about sewer stink or stuff like that.
en: Like, I'm not talking about sewer stink or stuff like that.
ja: その、下水の臭いとかそういうんじゃなくて。

key: I'm talking about rotting.
en: I'm talking about rotting.
ja: 腐敗臭の話をしてるの。

key: FLORA: Oh, that's why.
en: FLORA: Oh, that's why.
ja: フローラ: ああ、なるほど。

key: There's a dead body in this PULSE.
en: There's a dead body in this PULSE.
ja: このPULSEの中に死体があるわ。

key: Decaying.
en: Decaying.
ja: 腐敗してる。

key: This is fascinating.
en: This is fascinating.
ja: これは興味深いわね。

key: I thought PULSE machines could only have Pokémon inside of them.
en: I thought PULSE machines could only have Pokémon inside of them.
ja: PULSEの機械にはポケモンしか入れられないと思ってたんだけど。

key: Although, considering the state of this person, I don't think the outcome of being put into a PULSE machine was...
en: Although, considering the state of this person, I don't think the outcome of being put into a PULSE machine was...
ja: まあ、この人の状態を見る限り、PULSEに入れられた結果は……

key: Beneficial?
en: Beneficial?
ja: 有益だった、とは思えないわね?

key: Why do the PULSE machines have to hurt whatever's inside?
en: Why do the PULSE machines have to hurt whatever's inside?
ja: どうしてPULSEの機械は、中身を傷つけなきゃいけないのかしら。

key: Hmph.
en: Hmph.
ja: ヒルダ: ふん。

key: Well, this PULSE doesn't have an attachment.
en: Well, this PULSE doesn't have an attachment.
ja: まあ、このPULSEには付属品がないわね。

key: ...Technically.
en: ...Technically.
ja: ……厳密には。

key: But I don't really wanna get my hands dirty with some corpse.
en: But I don't really wanna get my hands dirty with some corpse.
ja: でも、死体なんかで手を汚したくないんだけど。

key: Don't you people know how to clean up your dead bodies? Or what?
en: Don't you people know how to clean up your dead bodies? Or what?
ja: あんたたち、死体の片付け方も知らないわけ? それとも何?

key: FLORA: Afraid of what? A dead body?
en: FLORA: Afraid of what? A dead body?
ja: フローラ: 何を怖がってるの? 死体?

key: Oh please, you remind me of Florin.
en: Oh please, you remind me of Florin.
ja: もう、あなた、フローリンを思い出させるわ。

key: That's my brother, by the way, but that's not important.
en: That's my brother, by the way, but that's not important.
ja: ちなみに私の兄なんだけど、まあそれはどうでもいいわ。

key: Of course I'm not scared of a dead body.
en: Of course I'm not scared of a dead body.
ja: もちろん死体なんか怖くないわよ。

key: It's just a clump of decaying garbage.
en: It's just a clump of decaying garbage.
ja: ただの腐ったゴミの塊じゃない。

key: FLORA: No.
en: FLORA: No.
ja: フローラ: 違う。

key: FLORA: It's not my dead body, and I don't know whoever this was.
en: FLORA: It's not my dead body, and I don't know whoever this was.
ja: フローラ: 私の死体でもないし、これが誰だったのかも知らない。

key: It's just a clump of decaying garbage now.
en: It's just a clump of decaying garbage now.
ja: 今はただの腐ったゴミの塊よ。

key: Let the authorities handle it, or let it rot into nothing.
en: Let the authorities handle it, or let it rot into nothing.
ja: 当局に任せるか、そのまま朽ち果てるに任せればいいわ。

key: FLORA: Oh, um... I mean...
en: FLORA: Oh, um... I mean...
ja: フローラ: あ、ええと……その……

key: It's scary!! Tee...hee!
en: It's scary!! Tee...hee!
ja: 怖いですぅ!! てへ……へへ!

key: Tee...hee...
en: Tee...hee...
ja: てへ……へへ……

key: I'm bored.
en: I'm bored.
ja: 退屈だわ。

key: I wasn't doing a good job of keeping up that cutesy facade in this region anyway.
en: I wasn't doing a good job of keeping up that cutesy facade in this region anyway.
ja: そもそも、この地方であの可愛子ぶった仮面をうまく保てていなかったし。

key: It's easier back home because everything is so bright and cheery that it seeps into your brain.
en: It's easier back home because everything is so bright and cheery that it seeps into your brain.
ja: 故郷ならもっと楽なのよ、何もかもが明るくて陽気で、それが頭にまで染み込んでくるから。

key: But here? I have a little trouble keeping a smile.
en: But here? I have a little trouble keeping a smile.
ja: でもここじゃ? 笑顔を保つのに、ちょっと苦労するわね。

key: Especially after SOMEONE immediately shows me to a dead body on the first thing I ask for.
en: Especially after SOMEONE immediately shows me to a dead body on the first thing I ask for.
ja: 特に、頼んだ最初のことがいきなり死体案内だった、なんてことがあった後じゃね。

key: I'm sure you can understand.
en: I'm sure you can understand.
ja: わかってもらえるはずよ。

key: Let's do this over again.
en: Let's do this over again.
ja: もう一度やり直しましょう。

key: My name is Flora Grevillea.
en: My name is Flora Grevillea.
ja: 私の名前はフローラ・グレヴィレア。

key: I'm a student at Axis High University, and I'm here because I want to learn how to make a PULSE machine.
en: I'm a student at Axis High University, and I'm here because I want to learn how to make a PULSE machine.
ja: アクシス大学の学生で、ここに来たのはPULSEの機械の作り方を学びたいから。

key: But I have no intention of creating a machine that will harm the innocent.
en: But I have no intention of creating a machine that will harm the innocent.
ja: でも、罪のない人を傷つける機械を作るつもりはないわ。

key: Back home there are certain people who trample over the weak.
en: Back home there are certain people who trample over the weak.
ja: 故郷には、弱い者を踏みにじる連中がいるの。

key: Those of "lower" status.
en: Those of "lower" status.
ja: 『下』の身分の者たち、ってやつね。

key: I'm bored of sitting around and watching those in power push around the weak.
en: I'm bored of sitting around and watching those in power push around the weak.
ja: 権力を持つ者が弱者を痛めつけるのを、ただ座って見てるのにはもう飽きた。

key: I'm going to be the difference.
en: I'm going to be the difference.
ja: 私が変化を起こしてみせる。

key: Listen, I'm done here. Can we leave now?
en: Listen, I'm done here. Can we leave now?
ja: ねえ、ここはもう十分。そろそろ行っていい?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ

key: Are you not afraid?
en: Are you not afraid?
ja: 怖くないの?

key: You clean it then.
en: You clean it then.
ja: だったら、あんたが片付けなさいよ。
